Definition: genitive case of ὁμός (the same; akin to G260) as adverb; at the same place or time:--together.
BiblicalUsage: The word homoû is together — a small word, used 4 times; John and Acts show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: homoû means together, and I do not stretch it further.
RelatedEvents: Jesus and the Samaritan Woman; Pentecost
